List, show, copy, move or remove projects.

A project holds a sandbox's chats, agent logins, workspace and tasks, in a folder in the projects directory (--projects-dir, or projects_dir in the config). Next to the folder are its saved settings (PROJECT.sandbox.yaml, for "codeflower sandbox --continue") and its allowlist (PROJECT.allowed-hosts.txt); its software environments may be in an env folder elsewhere (--env-dir). Copying, moving and removing a project take all of these along, and refuse while a sandbox uses the project.

Commands take a project's name, or the path of a project folder elsewhere.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower projects
```

## Examples

```sh
  codeflower projects list
  codeflower projects show study42
  codeflower projects copy study42 study42-v2
  codeflower projects move study42 /scratch/me/study42
  codeflower projects move-workspace study42 /groups/lab/me/workspaces
  codeflower projects remove study42-v2
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--env-dir string` |  | folder of the projects' env folders, for projects whose settings do not name one (or env_dir in the config) |
| `--projects-dir string` |  | folder of the projects started with --project (or projects_dir in the config; default ~/codeflower/projects) |

## Commands

- [`codeflower projects copy`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-copy/): Copy a project, e.g. to try something without changing it
- [`codeflower projects list`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-list/): List the projects in the projects directory
- [`codeflower projects move`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-move/): Rename a project, or move it to another folder
- [`codeflower projects move-workspace`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-move-workspace/): Move a project's workspace to another folder, e.g. one with more room
- [`codeflower projects remove`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-remove/): Delete a project and everything in it
- [`codeflower projects show`](/reference/cli/codeflower-projects-show/): Show where a project's files are and how it starts
